title: AIHOT normalized item v1
description: Strict normalized record projected from the public AIHOT v1 items API and an explicit SSR tag observation.

id.description: Public v1 API item id used for the API to SSR join.

aihot_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) AIHOT item URL copied from links.aihot.

original_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) original article URL copied from links.original; the primary exact-pairing input.

aihot_title.description: AIHOT display title copied without rewriting; used only after original_url and original_title for pairing.

original_title.description: originalTitle copied from the API; null only when the API explicitly returned null.

aihot_summary.description: AIHOT public API summary copied without rewriting; null only when explicitly returned.

upstream_publisher_name.description: Upstream publisher name copied from source.name.

published_at.description: RFC 3339 publishedAt string copied from the API; null only when explicitly returned.

aihot_discovered_at.description: RFC 3339 discoveredAt string copied from the AIHOT public API.

aihot_category_slug.description: AIHOT public API category slug copied as a string; future unknown slugs remain valid.

tags.description: Unique tags explicitly observed for this id over SSR. An empty array means observed with no tags, never a failed observation.

aihot_score_0_to_100.description: AIHOT public API score on the inclusive 0 to 100 scale; null only when explicitly returned.

aihot_recommendation_reason.description: AIHOT public API reason copied without rewriting; null only when explicitly returned.

api_record_projection_observation.description: Final row contains a complete public API record projection.

ssr_tags_observation.description: Final row tags were explicitly observed over SSR, including an observed empty array.
